<영적인 암발생 요인>

수년의 과정을 거쳐 암에 이르도록  죄로 더럽혀진 영적존재들이 하는 일은,.. 

벌레 마귀들의 활동 영역은 사람의 몸인데 특히 뱃속에 있을때는 장이나 간 또는 심장과 뱃속에서 활동하는데 거의 10년 정도는 증세가 전혀 보이지 않다가 10년이 지나면서 벌레알 집(물혹)이 커지면 증세가 몸밖에서 나타난다.

그러다가 장기능이 상실되면서 벌레들이 살기에 좋은 조건이 되면, 벌레가 주인이되어 암이 급속도로 퍼지면서 사람이 죽음에 이르는 악한 상황이 된다

이는 사람이나 영혼들이 악한 삶을 살거나 누군가에의해 지속적으로 고통을 당할때 암 발생률이 커지게 된다.

정말이지 예수 그리스도로부터 시작해서 벌레 영들에 이르기까지 많은 영적존재들이 사람에게 주는 고통은 이루 헤아릴수 없을 만큼 많은데...  이것이 다 영적인 일이라 대부분 기독교 신자들에게서 암이 발생하는 원인이 되기도 한다.


<육신과 집이 100% 육적으로 바껴야만 한다. >

대부분  혼적이거나 영적인 몸과 집은 영혼의 잔재들이 항상 남아있기 때문에 악령 악혼들이 그 안에 살면서 악해진다.

그래서 그 악령들을 육신과 집안에서 제거하지 않으면 손가락이나 무릎 뼈마디 피부속이나 어깻죽지에 들어가서 육신을 병들게 한다.

그러므로 조금이라도 가려우면 
"100% 육적으로 바껴!"를 여러번 한 다음, 털기, 저린 손가락 꺾기, 아픈 부위 두드리고 비비고 꾸욱 누르면서 "악령들 집밖으로 나가! 혹은 "단단히 묶여서 성층권에서 붙박이 해!" 하고 말하면 영적 존재들이 성층권으로 올라가서 얼게 된다.

믿기 어렵겠지만 신앙인들 특히 기도로 기름부음 받는 사람은  머리에 안테나가 있다. 안테나의 위치는 정수리 앞쪽 아기때 열려있던 숨구멍인데, 기도할때 올라갔다 내려갔다 하며 기름부음의 기적이 일어나 영적존재들이 악용하는 곳이다. 

이 안테나에 붙어서 악령들이 알을 까는데 기름의 기적을 이용해서 신앙인의 집과 교까에 수천억의 알을 까기 때문에 집안 곳곳이 보이지 않는 벌레 영들로 가득하게 된다. 그래서 시간이 지나면 이 점보다 작은 벌레영들이 알을 까서 사람의 피부속 어디에나 들어가서 먹고 자면서 육신과 더불어 산다.

그래서 기도하는 신앙인들이 이제부터는 하늘 어디에서도 아무도 듣지 않는 헛된 기도는 더이상 해서는 안되며 오직 감사로 즐거운 하루를 사는 것이 기름부음을 적게 하는 유일한 방법이다.

(성령)기도 하면 악령이 몰려온다. 천국에도 이제 성령이 없다고 한다. 기도에 매달리면 나처럼 극심한 고통에 시달리게 된다. 

그러나 머리에 기름이 많아서 매일 머리를 감는 사람들은 창조자의 능력이 있기 때문에 기름의 기적으로 악령 악혼 마귀를 물리칠수 있다.

믿지않는 일반 가정에는 영이 없지만 신심이 깊은 신자들에게는 영이 있기 때문에 어려운 일을 겪게되고 온몸이 쑤시거나 아픈 증세가 생기게 된다. 

이제 지구와 집과 육신을 육적으로 바꿔서 영적이고 혼적인 모든 껍질이 제거되야 한다 

인간만이 완전하다.
영혼들은 믹서기만 돌려도 놀라서 죽는 말할 수 없이 비참한 존재이고 악한 가짜들이기 때문에 "영껍질 혼껍질 다 훌러덩 벗겨져!" 하고 여러번 반복해서 외쳐서 내 몸에 붙어있는 알수없는 난의 혼들을 빼내고 깨끗한 육신으로만 행복하게 병 없이 오래 오래 살수 있어야 한다.


*통증으로부터 해방되자!
(손바닥과, 손가락이) 아플때...

1.모든 악령 악혼 마귀 사탄 귀신들..  기계없다! 고장났다! 기적없다!
기계 분리 분리!  배 열십자로 잘려!
기계몸 파괴 작살 분해 가루가되서 불에 타!  녹아없어져! 죽어없어져! 썩어없어져!
(안해도 됨. 영적빅뱅으로 영정리 끝났음)

2.생명줄 끊어져서 영원한 지옥으로 가!
3.악령 모두 죽어야 인류 살아!
4.새롭게되! 육적으로 정리되!

영적세계에는 하나님도 예수님도 없다. 다만 영과 혼이 있을 뿐이다. 그러나 그들은 모두 기계가 되었기에 더이상 훔숭받아야 할 존재가 아니다. 정말이지 비참하지만 어쩔수 없다. 

이 모든 것은 천사들을 일하도록 하기위해 대천사들이 만든 기계로부터 시작되었고 이 기계는 모든 것을 할 수 있는 능력을 가지고 있다. 그래서 영적인 모든 존재들은 기계 없이는 아무것도 할수 없고 다만 0초 기억력과 아이큐 0 만으로 사람에 의지하여 살고 있다. 

얼마 전까지만해도 영의 세계에는 기계 천국과 기계 지옥이 있었다. 하지만 창조주께서 천국과 지옥을 없애버렸다. 이유는 그 곳이 거룩하지 못하고 다만 악만 남아 있기 때문이다.

정말이지 거룩한 영혼들은 천국에 한명도 없다. 그들은 모두 지구상에 내려와 몰래 사람 몸속에 집을 짓고 거기서 먹고 마시며 자면서 주인의 육신을 망가뜨리고  점보다 작아져서 벌레처럼 산다

50대 이상된 자의 몸과 집안에는 반드시 보이지 않는 영적인 다양한 벌레들이 있다. 이들은 영적인 악의 세력에의해  기계가되어 육신 안에 묶여 살면서 밖으로 나가지도 못한채 몸 속에서 먹고 마시며 똥까지 싸서 집과 피부 속까지 더럽힌다. 이들은 모든 악으로서 사람에게 고통을 주고 사람의 인성까지 악하게 만든다. 

그러므로 몸에 통증이 있는 사람은 통증이 사라질때까지 꾸~욱 누르면서 다음과 같이 말하면 통증이 완화될 수 있다. 

"내적 외적으로 내 몸안에 숨어있는 기계가된 영적 존재들인 악령. 악혼. 마귀. 사탄. 벌레영 벌레알은, "손 잘려! 집 밖으로 빠져나가! 파괴폭팔!. 파괴폭팔!. 파괴폭팔! 분해 되! 가루가 되! 불에 타! 녹아! 죽어 없어져"!!!! (통증이 있을때 속으로 혹은 겉으로  매일 지속적으로 해야됨)하고 속으로도 하고 입술로도 말하면 많은 악의 세력과 기계들이 빠져 나간다.

이 모든 것은 첫번째 기계 예수인 아담과 두번째 기계 아담인 예수 때문에 일어난 일이고 이 때문에 하늘에서 나를 사용하였으며 이로인해 나는 3년 동안 고통을 받았고 그 고통을 통해서 알아낸 진실이다.

그동안 내 좋은 두뇌를 바보로 바꾼 기계, 내 머리에 똥싸고 오줌싸서 더럽혔던 영적 존재들과 기계, 내 고운 피부를 기미와 점 투성이로 엉망이 되게한 영적존재들, 피를 빨이먹어서 내 심장을 걸레처럼 만든 흡혈귀 마귀들, 특히 나의 몸 뼈속깊이 박혀서 뼈를 갉아먹는 벌레 영들을 오늘 다 빼낸 후에 거울을 보니 내 얼굴이 다시 예전처럼 예뻐 보였다.

text_original:
Sedikit cerita Trauma saat berkunjung ke Gn Merapi di 2017. Saat itu sy umur 17th, diajak liburan keluarga ke Jogja. Sebelumnya sy gak ikutin berita Gn Merapi 2010 karna dulu masih SD jd kurang tertarik. Singkatnya nih kita naik ke Gn Merapi, dgn polosnya sy happy2 aja gatau kisah dibaliknya. 
Kalian tau kan kalo menuju kesana naik mobil Offroad dan jalannya lumayan panjang bebatuan dikelilingi pepohonan.
Dan di sepanjang jalan itu dimana yang lain ketawa2 keseruan, aku diem nahan nangis. 
Karna dengan jelas dikupingku denger suara teriakan orang2, anak kecil berlarian diiringi suara jeritan ayam, sapi, kambing. Dan yang sy liat debu jalanan tuh tebel bgt sampe sy merem takut kelilipan. Sampe basecam (rumah mbah marijan) sy duduk di bangku kayu panjang. Diem, terus ditegor sama abang2 supir mobilnya kata dia "dek, jangan dipikirin nggeh".
Lanjut sy ngikut aja masuk ke rumah mbah marijan, didepan pintu tertulis 'Rumah Mbah Maridjan' (kalo gasalah ingat) 
Nah disitu lah baru kepikiran kok ga asing namanya. 
Ada satu ruangan yg gak boleh dimasuki, tp pengujung pada ngintip di pintunya katanya kosong ga ada apa2. Tp yg sy liat masih ada bayangan abu hitam dan bawaan mau nangis akhirnya sy keluar.😢
Oya berkunjung juga ke Bunker nya saat itu masih gelap gulita gatau kalo sekarang. Didalem ketika orang bilang "kok adem ya padahal dibawah tanah kaya goa" 
Loh aku nih sesek baru selangkah dari pintu gakuat eneg juga😮
Langsung minta pulang ke Jakarta. 
FYI emang sy sedikit peka, apalagi pendengaran sama penciuman, turunan dari bapak. 
Kalo mata batin gamau di asah takut karna gampang ketempelan

text_original:
waktu itu aku masih SD dan bener-bener ikut ngerasain gimana gentingnya kondisi ketika malam itu merapi erupsi. aku masih inget banget gimana kerasnya suara kerikil dan pasir yg menimpa atap rumah dan saat gelap-gelapan ngelewatin kebon salak yg pohonnya merunduk grgr ketiban abu vulkanik waktu dievakuasi buat ngungsi. malam yg super chaos! saking traumanya, bahkan sampe sekarang aku suka waswas klo denger suara letusan yg tiba-tiba gitu. trs dulu gempar bgt tuh soal berita wafatnya mbah maridjan ini. saat itu blm punya hp sendiri, yt jg blm booming. tp aku suka cari-cari berita dan video evakuasinya mbah maridjan di yt, krn kalimat "meninggal dlm keadaan sujud" tu bener-bener bikin amazed buatku saat itu yg masih kecil. mana mbah kakungku jg dlu sama—nggak mau ikut ngungsi, udh dibujuk tp tetep nolak krn katanya mau jagain kampungku soalnya para warganya pada pergi. kebetulan mbahku jg org yg dituakan di kampung. yah vibesnya kayak mbah maridjan gitu, dihormati krn dipercaya cukup ahli soal hal-hal klenik/ghoib gini. tp beliau udh gak ada 2 thn lalu krn sakit. al fatihah buat almarhum mbah kakungku dan mbak maridjan 🥀

—and by the way, happy belated birthday ya kak nadiaaaa!!!!🎉 meskipun aku jarang ninggalin komen, tp aku selalu bersyukur dan terima kasih sebanyak-banyaknya atas video-video kakak. aku harap Allah selalu jagain kak nadia sekeluarga. sehat terus ya kak, panjang umur, dan selalu diberkahi hal-hal dan orang-orang baik yang mengelilingi kak nadia. im forever thankful karena kamu udah terlahir kak. story telling-mu jadi salah sumber semangat terbesarku buat tetep nunggu hari esok 💖

text_original: Erupsi Merapi tahun 2010 aku kls 3 Mts, tempatku 20km dari puncak Merapi, tepatnya di kota Muntilan, aku ingat pas erupsi semakin intensif, hujan abu berhari hari semakin lebat hingga jarak 20 km itupun bisa hujan pasir dan kerikil yg masih hangat, pohon pohon mati, pasar tutup total karena hujan abu semakin tebal dan jalan menjadi licin. Kecelakaan dimana mana Krn air hujan bercampur abu membuat roda selip, makanan kami terbatas, lambat Laun beras habis, pasar tutup warungpun kehabisan beras. Kami memanfaatkan nasi aking ( Karak nasi / nasi basi yg dikeringkan ulang) kami memasaknya ulang dengan lauk garam dan kalaupun ada yg bisa kita olah itu gori/ nangka muda. Awalnya emak masih punyaa beberapa bumbu seperti garam dan bumbu dapur lainnya, selanjutnya gori itu hanya direbus Krn benar benar tidak ada lagi bumbu dirumah, 2 Minggu listrik padam,  saat di rumah tidak ada makanan yang bisa kami olah emak dan beberapa tetangga terpaksa ke kelurahan, disana ada tempat pengungsian dan dapur umum, kita meminta bantuan makanan ke kelurahan,  tapi waktu itu kepala desa memberikan 1 dus mie untuk dibagikan ke 4 keluarga, 10 bungkus per KK, kita benar benar menghemat makanan karena kita kena dampak juga tapi bantuan blm datang, setelah lebih dari 2 Minggu pasokan bantuan datang, listrik mulai menyala sebagian, belum selesai erupsi datang banjir lahar dingin, banyak rumah jembatan sawah kolam yang hanyut terbawa arus, beberapa hal diluar nalar juga terjadi, seperti kalau terdengar suara musik gamelan seperti musik Jathilan dari kejauhan nanti banjir lahar dingin bakalan besar, dan masyarakat sekitar pasti paham hal tersebut

author: @aii_bttmlss
text_original:
aku salah satu yang terdampak letusan gunung merapi dulu, rumahku 11 km jauhnya dari puncak gunung merapi. Akhirnya aku dan keluarga sempat mengungsi ke rumah nenek di sleman yang letak rumahnya masih jauh dibawah rumahku, tapi kebetulan rumahnya nenekku itu tidak jauh dari sungai/kali krasak

waktu itu aku masih SD kelas 4. pas sampai sana tuh ternyata tetangga nenekku semua juga pada ngungsi karena takut terkena lahar dingin, cuma rumah nenekku aja yg ngga ngungsi soalnya buat tempat aku dan keluarga. kampung sudah sepi sekali. 

hari itu tuh lagi hujan deras sekali, campur sama material dari gunung juga. suaranya lahar dingin dari kali krasak tuh nyampe kedengeran di rumah nenekku. pas itu semua keluarga sudah tidur, aku juga sudah tidur tapi tiba-tiba aku kebangun jam 1 malam padahal aku gapernah kaya gitu. dan diwaktu itu lah aku denger ada SUARA GAMELAN YANG SANGAT JELAS kedengeran di sela-sela hujan deras dan suara lahar dingin. padahal suara lahar dinginnya tuh keras loh soalnya dia bawa batu-batu besar, kedengeran glodok-glodoknya. Tapi aku beneran jelas banget kedengeran gamelannya. Suaranya tuh kaya dari jauhh trus mendekat trus jauh lagi seakan-akan dia numpang lewat gitu

Awalnya aku mikir, ah paling radio org yg lagi jaga. tapi itu nyampe jam 2 malem ga berhenti suaranya padahal depan rumah tidak ada org sama sekali. trus aku juga sempet mikir, ah paling ada yg latian tari tradisional jadinya muter gamelan. tapi pas itu juga desa udah sepi banget, 80% orang udah ngungsi. PUN, kalo ada org ga mungkin mereka latihan pas hujan deras bawa material erupsi sama pas lagi ada lahar dingin gitu. 

Waktu itu aku masih kecil, takutnya bukan main. Mau coba bangunin sepupu sama saudaraku mereka gada yang bangun. Sampai jam 2/3-an malam aku lupa, baru suaranya makin menjauh makin menjauh dan ilang. Baru pas itu aku bisa tidur lagi. Badannya panas dingin kaya kena ketindihan tapi gabisa tidur.

Pas paginya aku tanya ke keluarga mereka nganggapnya aku bercanda atau bohong soalnya mereka sama sekali ngga kebangun dan ngga dengerin ada suara gamelan sama sekali. cuma aku doang yg denger selama 1 jam lebih 😭

sumpah Demi allah aku ga bohong ga mengada-ada. anak kelas 4 SD gabakal mikir keuntungan apa yang dia dapat dari bohong macam ginian. pun aku juga skrg udah gede masih ingat betul suara gamelan itu. mau coba bohongin dan meyakinkan diri sendiri kalo itu halusinasi pun kayanya gamungkin soalnya aku beneran stay bangun dengerin gamelan 1 JAM LEBIH, cukup waktu ini mah buat analisis itu bohongan atau bukan, itu halusinasi atau bukan. 

nyampe sekarang aku juga gatau itu suara gamelan darimana. apakah dari suara radio, HP, ada yang latihan gamelan, atau memang ada pasukan yang lewat kali krasak buat menuju ke tempat tertentu wallahu alam

text_original:
Sedikit cerita, sy asli Jogja tepatnya di kab. Bantul
Th 2006 saat kejadian erupsi merapi masih SD kelas 3, setelah erupsi berturut turut sebulan lebih tidak berhenti disusul gempa hebat 27 Mei 2006, pusatnya di darat di Bantul kerusakan parah korban meninggal banyak sekali, waktu gempa suaranya gemuruh krn ratusan/ribuan rumah yang ambruk, ditambah suara riuh pohon bambu depan rumah sy, masih inget banget pasca gempa erupsi merapi semakin parah, setiap malam kami di jogsel ramai2 dipinggiran sawah meligat erupsi merapi krn kalau siang yg terlihat hanya wedus gembel/asap mengepul, tp kalau malam itu lava pijar terlihat seperti gerumpulan api turun dari lereng gunung, ngeri kali wakk.. Setiap malam loh itu, sebelum keluar pasti ada suara gemuruh dan warga akan ramai2 melihatnya. Semua warga dihimbau pasang ketupat dirumah termasuk keluarga saya
Erupsi merapi 2006 aman. Tapi ternyata di tahun 2010 pecahh letusan gunung merapi yg menyebabkan adanya pecahan gunung semakin menganga ke arah timur. 
Ingat betul, 2010 pagi buta jam4 subuh kami dihebohkan dengan hujan abu semakin lama semakin pekattt, semua aktifitas siswa/pekerja diliburkan 
Semakin siang hujan abu semakin pekat, jarak pandang mata mungkin hanya 5-10 meter, ketebalan di daerah saua jogsel ada mungkin 10cm 
Hujan abu berlangsung berhari hari, seperti hujan air pada umumnya, kadang deras kadang gerimis, keos nya ledakan hebat yang menyebabkan juru kunci mbah marijan meninggal dunia, wahh itu suasana Jogja udah berduka sekali artinya merapi sedang tidak main2. 
Sampe sekarang ini, traumanya saya wak kalo sama suara gemuruh, pengennya lari keliar rumah. Dan semenjak gempa 2006 sampe detik ini, Jogja sering gempa dengan intensitas yg kecil, biasanya pusat di laut di arah gunungkidul
Pasca letusan merapi 2010 abu vulkanik itu bertahun tahun tidak hilang gitu aja di lingkungan desa, menyatu dengan tanah setiap ada angin berhembuss abu terbang ke teras2 rumah, pokoknya susah kali lah debu lembut itu ngepelnya kalo udh masuk rumah. 
Tenang-tenang ya Merapi, sehat sehat Jogjaku ❤❤❤❤

Pas erupsi inget banget masih SMA, semuanya sibuk ngungsi pada panik. Sodara ku tengah malem pada ngungsi ditempatku. Siang nya udah panik lagi. Banyak kecelakaan juga pas dijalan raya. Ini saya waktu itu ijin kerja karena kabutnya tebel bgt ga dipercaya dan ga diijinin tetep disuurh berangkat sama juragan. Eh pas orang kantor survei langsung. Dia yang panik nyuruh buru2 beres ga jadi dagang. Udah pulang aja... lah kita nyebrang jalan udah kayak hidup dan mati. 😢

text_original: rumahku Magelang, 15 th yang lalu pas gunung merapi meletus ak kerja di jogja. tiap hari nglaju pulang pergi. author: @CentralCommandHomeBase
text_original:
Firstly, that isn't the sound of rain falling. The volcanic particles are being blown up miles into the atmosphere. It's then they cool and solidify and rain back to Earth as solid pieces. Those particles can be blown out by the jet stream miles ahead or behind a volcanic column. 
Furthermore, the gray cloud you see encroaching and retracting is a pyroclastic flow--not lava. It's superheated gas that is hotter than lava, hence why it singed the jungle, and why it kept regressing and, then, advancing.  
Furthermore, there is no thunderstorm; all the lightning and thunder you hear is from the volcanic material itself. 
The video encapsulates the absolute terror that the people of 79 A.D. Pompeii experienced, and it validates the first-hand accounts of what that eruption looked like.

Extremely dense and superheated gas and rock are pushed by the eruption and gravity outward at enormous rates of speed for the size of these flows. 

But when it pulls back, what you are seeing is that superhot gas cool with the air of the surrounding area making it less buoyant, so the flow and clouds begin to collapse downward, but the backdraft is in part refilling the vacuum left from pushing all of those gases and rocks outward. So you are seeing hot air cool, get pulled to the ground and then backward to fill the vacuum left behind it.

The paradox of nature enthralls me — its push and pull, its losses and rebirths. Technology lets us witness these geographical events up close, reminding us that life persists despite hardship.

As a direct descendant of the Gabrielino-Tongva Tribe of the San Gabriel Valley in Southern California, I know my ancestors, like many Indigenous peoples, honored every aspect of life. While history books often erase these practices, our traditions taught that taking life required forgiveness and gratitude. A deer’s heart or brain was returned to the Earth, symbolizing respect and renewal — ashes to ashes, dust to dust.

This is not about celebrating loss, but about recognizing the balance: the negative and positive working together, because life goes on...

author: @jillcherrick3113
text_original:
Great video sound and all. Crazy how it sounds like rain falling but really its vibrations in the air. Great footage of atmospheric dynamics. 
Storm over head. Lightning, idicactes a charged ash plum interacting with storm cells. Leaves shacking due to air pressure pulses, and not the result or sound of anything raining down. The sound of trees igniting and or exploding in the background. And then the smoke reversing direction. Being pushed by a combination of a cold downdraft and eruption convection ( hot air and ash rise violently. Cold surrounding air rushes downward around it. The downwards air pushes ash at the margins inward. Which causes the strange reversal effect where the ash cloud that was flowing downslope suddenly curls back towards the vent or appears to lift upwards again) 4th and 6th grade science for gen x and before. Not sure what they teach, if anything now. Notice the ground plain is still on fire with a forward consumption. This has been documented before.  Mount St Helens (1980) -I was a 5 year old in Montana-. Ash clouds reversed direction briefly due to cold front downdrafts. Hunga Toga (2022) cloud edges folded inward due to extreme convection-driven inflow. Merapi Indonesia pyro flows repeatedly hit the valley wind boundaries and rolled back upslope. Southeast Asian Volcanoes, including Semeru, experience this often because they erupt into humid, storm-influenced tropical atmospheres. 
So nothing new here other than the great footage that was captured.
Thanks for the video.❤😊

text_original:
@SonderYoga A pyroclastic flow, also called nuée ardente ("glowing cloud" in French), is a cloud of hot gasses - typically carbon dioxide, sulfur dioxide, and others - and pulverized rock fragments sometimes expelled during volcanic eruptions. Typically, the temperature of the cloud is around 400-600°C (800-1100°F), but can exceed 1,000°C (1,800°F). They can be so hot that as the ash settles, it melts, flows, and welds itself into a solid mass called an "ignimbrite."

At Herculaneum, during the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D., dozens of people hid in caves by the harbor, hoping to evacuate. Instead, they were enveloped and buried by one of several pyroclastic flows ejected by the volcano. The temperature was hot enough, likely around 750°C, to flash-boil their blood and other bodily fluids, causing some victims' skulls to burst. They were dead before they had time to scream. The people of Pompeii weren't that fortunate. The flesh of Herculaneum's people was burned off their bones, leaving only roasted skeletons. While the people of Pompeii were baked alive as they suffocated, their bodies and clothing were left mostly intact, allowing modern researchers to make the casts the city is now so famous for.

text_original: ​ @davebenjamin5617 that depends on the type of volcano and the lava that they produce. Hawaii sits on a hot spot where fresh magma from the mantle moves up. This one here is a volcano close to a subduction zone, where one tectonic plate moves under another. The plate gets molten, and drags water with it. The result is a quite viscous material with a lot of water, i.e., gas. They produce these kinds of pyroclastic flows.

It’s not lava. It’s a pyroclastic flow, A pyroclastic flow is a fast-moving, high-density avalanche of volcanic ash, pumice, lava blocks, and hot gas that explodes from a volcano. These deadly, hurricane-force mixtures can reach speeds of 200 miles per hour and temperatures exceeding 1,500°F. They are heavier than air and move like snow avalanches, but are much hotter and contain toxic gases. 
It’s the type of flow that wiped out Pompeii. If that had been lava, we wouldn’t have the artifacts and relics we do from Pompeii

text_original: @SamA-on8td  I think the bigger picture is that as the eruption launches a large volume up in the air it creates a large surrounding donut shaped vortex with the outsides going down. As the eruption runs out of steam (pun intended) the erupted material falls back due to gravity, creating the pyroclastic flow. As that gravitational fall runs out of inertia, the giant donut shaped vortex pushes back which is what we see. Very interesting!

author: @marshallsweatherhiking1820
text_original: @jorgenastrand46   I think the ash current moves so fast there is a lot of turbulent mixing.  As it mixes with clean air at the leading edge, the portion of the cloud’s density induced by suspended particles drops faster than its temperature.  Eventually the ash cloud is less dense than the surrounding air because the gas within is still very hot (and thus less dense because the air / gas molecules are spread out).  The fact that the cloud is a mixture of hot gas and suspended particles makes the physics somewhat complex.  Both the gas and the suspended particles contribute to density, and thus both contribute to the pressure gradients that control the flow of the cloud as a whole.

author: @marshallsweatherhiking1820
text_original: @admiralbenbow5083  The amount of ash particles per cubic meter decreases as the cloud expands and mixes into the surrounding air.  Because the gaseous component of the cloud is much hotter than the surrounding air, this component is also less dense than the surrounding air.  At the beginning, the extreme concentration of ash particles makes the cloud more dense than the surrounding air, despite the gaseous part being less dense. The density of the cloud is determined by the combination of these two components.

author: @VelvetAura
text_original: @tripsix263  you think you're so smart because you claim nothing is real lol. What we're seeing here is rare but not unprecedented. The flow slowed once it reached a flatter area, desposited, then likely the flow head collapsed under its own weight and began to cool/entrain air faster than new hot gas was arriving. This can cause a brief backflow like we saw in this video. You can see volcanic condensation clouds forming and building around the base before the second pulse. This is from ambient air rapidly cooling and condensing due to either strong heat loss, pressure fluctuations, or moisture condensing as it's being pulled into expanding turbulence. The second flow we saw was caused by either new material collapsing from the dome/vent, or the core of the initial flow re-pressurizing as the trail catches up. This is not the first time this has happened, and Semeru Volcano has documented instances of it happening before. Semeru’s dome collapses in discrete chunks, each collapse feeding a new pyroclastic pulse that rides over or re-mobilizes the previous deposit. Hope you learned something today

Surat Terbuka untuk Komunitas Drone-Ekspedisi dan Penjelajah Medan Berat

Kepada rekan-rekan komunitas drone-ekspedisi yang terbiasa menjelajahi gunung, lembah, dan hulu sungai dengan akses medan berat,

Saat ini beberapa wilayah di Sumatera tengah menghadapi kondisi longsor dan kerusakan lingkungan yang cukup serius. Banyak area hulu yang sebelumnya tertutup hutan telah berubah akibat aktivitas manusia yang tidak bertanggung jawab. Perubahan ini menyebabkan instabilitas tanah, aliran air terganggu, dan risiko bencana meningkat.

Kemampuan dan pengalaman rekan-rekan dalam mengoperasikan drone di medan ekstrem memiliki nilai yang sangat penting. Melalui pemetaan udara, dokumentasi visual, dan penelusuran jalur aliran air hingga ke hulu, komunitas drone dapat memberikan data nyata mengenai:

titik longsor yang aktif,

pola kerusakan bentang alam,

bukaan lahan yang memicu aliran air deras,

serta potensi risiko lanjutan yang mungkin belum teridentifikasi dari darat.


Data seperti ini sangat membantu pihak terkait dalam mitigasi, kajian teknis, dan langkah penanganan lanjutan.

Dengan ini, kami mengajak rekan-rekan komunitas untuk berkontribusi dalam pemetaan kondisi aktual di lapangan. Partisipasi Anda akan sangat berarti bagi upaya pemulihan dan pencegahan bencana yang lebih besar di masa mendatang.
